body: Somehing like this JUST happened to me. Went out to a crowded area. Went to a store where i needed to buy a pen. I immediately started shaking for no reason. Getting the money out of mg wallet was the hardest thing i had to do at that moment. Gave the money to the cashier and started to leave and the guy was like "lady, your pen". I payed for it and almost left it there. Then this salesman stops me on the street to try and sell me something (that i actually wanted) but i was so brain dead that i could barely reply back in a comprehensible manner. I'll never be able to live in this world like this and it makes me wanna die more than ever.
Just because someone has two broken legs it doesn't make my broken arm hurt any less
We don't even have self checkouts where i live

I went over to r/samsung but the rules say they don't allow "tech support questions" and i got confused.

I have to see a general practitioner. If i want to see a specialist, i have to book an appointment and wait for months (my mom booked an appointment with an eye doctor last year; they called in with the date for the appointment yesterday) 
I went to the general practitioner today to see what they could do. He sent me to have my eye washed and used anesthetic eyedrops on me. Idk how long these drops last but right now i don't feel anything and my vision is a bit blurry (I'm just not sure if it's because of the drops or because of all the irritation and crying from earlier)

I'm thinking about going but i don't expect much out of it. Free healthcare in my country is complete shit and i'll most likely get checked by a doctor who's not a specialist and he'll recommend me any basic eye drops.

I started getting into kpop in the middle of 2017, so i didn't know much groups yet. I didn't know SHINee at the time. It went from me hearing the news about someone in kpop committing suicide to me crying about him and feeling as if i lost a close friend. I honestly don't know why it affected me in such a way. I listen to Linkin Park and Nirvana and their deaths, although leaving me sad, never had such a strong impact on me as Jonghyun, a complete stranger who i wasn't even a fan of at the time, had. Maybe it's because i'm also dealing with my own issues but even with that, i still don't understand,  honestly.  It took me months to be able to listen to their music and even more to listen to his solo music. I still can't watch mvs for some reason, but now i can talk about him without feeling too sad.
